set.body:
Supersedes closed epic bd-01KX1P6Z3RW3T4GSZ4MT86Z7QQ rather than reopening it.

Objective
Make Gale the canonical generic numerical substrate for Scalafim and remove modules/linalg, modules/linalg-breeze, and related generic matrix and solver duplicates without weakening JVM or Scala.js correctness, domain typing, or hot-kernel performance.

Target boundary
Gale owns DMat and DVec, dense and sparse storage, generic operator algebra, factorizations, spectral methods, iterative solvers, diagnostics, and backend routing. Scalafim retains domain errors and solve policies, MatrixView storage semantics, typed multivariate spaces and operator evidence, graph and affine domain wrappers, result provenance, and HRF complex and FFT support.

Review snapshot 2026-07-19
118 production files outside modules/linalg reference scalafim.linalg. Hot consumers rely on direct primitive-array construction and matrix right-hand sides. Gale is the correct architectural destination but first needs pivoted configurable QR, matrix-RHS QR and Cholesky solves, efficient shared matrix construction, and additional operator composition and batch application. Eigen ordering, triangle validation, full-spectrum routing, SVD orientation, rank policies, and error mapping require explicit semantic adapters. Scalafim Scala.js 1.20.1 cannot load Gale build settings; an isolated probe passed on JVM and fullLinkJS after alignment to Scala.js 1.22.0.

Migration doctrine
Land Gale prerequisites and a reproducible pinned artifact first. Replace carriers directly rather than establishing permanent Scalafim type aliases. Migrate consumers in finite slices, preserve domain wrappers, and delete the old engine only after dependency scans and numerical gates prove every consumer has moved.

Epic acceptance
- Gale dependency is tagged or otherwise reproducibly pinned; no durable publishLocal dependency.
- Scala.js toolchain is aligned and both JVM and JS compile and test after every migration slice.
- No production imports of scalafim.linalg remain.
- modules/linalg and modules/linalg-breeze plus obsolete build aliases and backend-strategy docs are removed.
- Generic private eigensolver, SVD, inverse, QR, and dense matrix helper families are removed or justified as domain-specific.
- Fit and multivar R-parity fixtures pass; spectral ordering, residual, orthogonality, symmetry, rank, and convergence contracts are explicit.
- Allocation and performance guardrails cover OLS response blocks, MatrixView dense and sparse paths, graph operators, and small motion solves.
- Full compileAll, testAll, warning-clean build, git diff --check, and final dependency scans pass.
set.title: Epic: migrate Scalafim linear algebra to Gale and retire internal linalg
